expectedMisconceptions: Test-and-refine can end up applied as one overall pass rather than a separate cycle per fault — worth checking each diagnosed fault gets its own test-and-refine attempt.

Repair order can get chosen by which fault seems easiest to fix rather than which is most critical to fix first — the mission's own assessment specifically looks for a sequence justified by reasoning, not ease.
stretchQuestions: If you could only fix two of the faults today, which two would you choose, and why?
What's the risk of testing a fix and moving straight to the next fault without confirming it actually worked?
estimatedSupervision: Moderate — adult involvement recommended for the signal-path experiment (see `generated/resources/experiments.json`, Mission 15 entry); simple materials for modelling the tower are optional but can help.
